title: Muons Shouldn't Reach the Ground. They Do.

input.text:
Muons from cosmic rays live only two millionths of a second — barely 600 metres of flight — yet they reach the ground because their clocks run slow.

What Happens If You Travel Near Light Speed?

Did you know cosmic-ray particles are passing through you right now because of Einstein's time dilation?

Full film on YouTube. Link in bio.

#CosmicRays #Muons #SpeedOfLight #EinsteinRelativity #LorentzFactor
